issues.display_title: Issue #213: API Get All Published Exhibitions with Restricted Access and Pagination
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: API Get All Published Exhibitions with Restricted Access and Pagination

Files Changed / Added

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions.go (new action handler)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions_test.go (new unit test file)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (added GetPublishedExhibitions)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes.go (registered GET /published before /:sid)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes_test.go (new route integration test file)

Summary of Implementation

Implemented a new API endpoint GET /v1/exhibitions/published allowing authorized administrators (albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com) to retrieve all published exhibitions in the platform with pagination metadata and descending creation order.

The implementation strictly mirrors the exhibition object format of /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions, attaches creator user information, eliminates unnecessary internal fields (user_id, exhibition_id, large 3D scene data), and provides clean, canonical pagination metadata (total and totalPages).

Detailed Changes

1. Action Handler (src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions.go)

  • Authorization Check:
    • Validates authentication via helpers.GetAuthUser(c).
    • Uses IsAllowedPublishedExhibitionsEmail(email) to restrict access to albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com (case-insensitive, trimmed).
    • Returns 403 Forbidden if the user is not authorized.
  • Safe Pagination Parsing:
    • ParseExhibitionPagination(pageStr, limitStr, defaultLimit, maxLimit) safely parses page (default 1) and limit (default 10, max 100), calculating offset = (page - 1) * limit.
    • Calculates total pages via integer arithmetic: (total + limit - 1) / limit.
  • Database Query Optimization & Safety:
    • Passes Fiber request context via config.DB.WithContext(c.Context()) to prevent orphaned queries upon client cancellation.
    • Filters published = ? AND deleted = ? with true, false.
    • Counts total matching records before applying pagination.
    • Uses .Select(...) and .Preload(...) with explicit column selection (id, username, email, first_name, last_name, avatar) to avoid loading sensitive fields (password hashes, encrypt tokens) and multi-megabyte 3D scene JSONB columns (published_data, saved_data).
    • Orders by created_at DESC, id DESC for deterministic pagination.
  • Response Format:
    • Formats exhibition items with id, name (HTML unescaped), thumbnail, published, description, started, share_string, ended, unlimited_time, countdown_timer, cover_image, model_type, and nested user.
    • Excludes user_id and exhibition_id from the exhibition item.
    • Returns pagination metadata strictly as total, totalPages, page, limit, and exhibitions.

2. Controller (src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go)

Exposes the action method:

func GetPublishedExhibitions(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
    return exhibitionaction.GetPublishedExhibitions(c)
}

3. Route Configuration (src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes.go)

Registers the static route before the dynamic parameterized route /:sid:

func registerExhibitionRoutes(r fiber.Router) {
    exhibitions := r.Group("/exhibitions")
    exhibitions.Get("/published", controllers.GetPublishedExhibitions)
    exhibitions.Get("/:sid", controllers.GetExhibitionDetail)
    ...
}

Registering /published prior to /:sid guarantees that Fiber matches /v1/exhibitions/published rather than treating "published" as an exhibition identifier parameter (:sid).

Verification & Tests

Automated Tests

  1. src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions_test.go:

    • TestIsAllowedPublishedExhibitionsEmail: Tests whitelist compliance with case variations, extra whitespace, and unauthorized emails.
    • TestParseExhibitionPagination: Tests defaults, custom values, negative/zero inputs, non-numeric values, and upper-bound caps.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_UnauthorizedEmailForbidden: Verifies that authenticated users with unauthorized emails receive 403 Forbidden.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_Unauthenticated: Verifies that requests without user identity receive 401 Unauthorized.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_AllowedEmailProceedsToDatabase: Verifies that albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com pass authorization and proceed to database execution.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_WithJWT: Verifies end-to-end token consumption and authorization.

  2. src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes_test.go:

    • TestPublishedExhibitionRoutesRequireAuth: Verifies that GET /v1/exhibitions/published requires a JWT token.
    • TestPublishedExhibitionRouteDoesNotCollideWithSid: Verifies that /published route is evaluated independently without colliding into /:sid.

Test Execution

go test -v ./src/action/v1/exhibition ./src/routes/v1
go test ./...

All 76 packages and test suites pass successfully.

Overview

Create an authenticated API endpoint to retrieve all published exhibitions (GET /v1/exhibitions/published). This endpoint is restricted exclusively to authorized operators with emails albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com. The endpoint supports pagination (page and limit), orders exhibitions by created_at DESC, id DESC, returns overall pagination metadata (total, totalPages, page, limit), and formats the exhibition data to match /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions while including creator (user) information.

Requirements

  1. Access Control:
    • Only authenticated users with verified emails albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com are allowed.
    • Unauthenticated requests must return 401 Unauthorized.
    • Authenticated users with other email addresses must return 403 Forbidden.
  2. Data Filtering & Sorting:
    • Only return exhibitions where published = true and deleted = false.
    • Order exhibitions by created_at DESC, id DESC.
  3. Pagination:
    • Support page query parameter (integer, default: 1).
    • Support limit query parameter (integer, default: 10, max: 100).
    • Compute totalPages based on total matching published exhibitions.
    • Return total representing the overall count of published exhibitions across all pages.
  4. Data Contract:
    • Mirror /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions for the exhibition properties (id, name, thumbnail, published, description, started, share_string, ended, unlimited_time, countdown_timer, cover_image, model_type).
    • Exclude user_id, exhibition_id, and unnecessary heavy internal scene configs from the exhibition fields.
    • Include the creator user object (id, username, email, first_name, last_name, avatar) without leaking password hashes or encryption tokens.
    • Response envelope metadata must strictly use total and totalPages without redundant aliases (totalCount or total_pages).

Scope

In scope:

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions.go (business logic, email whitelist verification, query with pagination and creator preload)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping to action)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes.go (route registration placed before dynamic /:sid)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions_test.go (unit tests for email checks, pagination parsing, and authorization)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes_test.go (route integration tests for auth enforcement and routing precedence)

Out of scope:

  • Modifying existing exhibition viewer or public profile endpoints.
  • Database schema migrations.

API Specification

  • Endpoint: GET /v1/exhibitions/published
  • Authentication: Bearer JWT Token
  • Query Parameters:
    • page (optional, default: 1): Current page number.
    • limit (optional, default: 10, max: 100): Items per page.
  • Headers:
    • Authorization: Bearer <token>

Success Response (200 OK)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Get Exhibition success",
    "total": 42,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "totalPages": 5,
    "exhibitions": [
      {
        "id": "c1f7b8d4-6e11-4f9a-883a-44243a059d04",
        "user": {
          "id": "a2e8c9d0-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678",
          "username": "creator",
          "email": "creator@example.com",
          "first_name": "John",
          "last_name": "Doe",
          "avatar": null
        },
        "name": "Gallery Title",
        "thumbnail": "https://...",
        "published": true,
        "description": "Gallery description",
        "started": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "share_string": "gallery-title-xyz",
        "ended": null,
        "unlimited_time": true,
        "countdown_timer": true,
        "cover_image": "https://...",
        "model_type": "3d"
      }
    ]
  }
}

Error Responses

  • 401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid Bearer token.
  • 403 Forbidden: Authenticated user email is not in the allowed list (albugsp@gmail.com, villumesupport@gmail.com).

Acceptance Criteria

  1. GET /v1/exhibitions/published without token returns 401 Unauthorized.
  2. Valid token with email other than albugsp@gmail.com or villumesupport@gmail.com returns 403 Forbidden.
  3. Valid token with albugsp@gmail.com or villumesupport@gmail.com returns 200 OK.
  4. Only exhibitions with published = true and deleted = false are returned.
  5. Pagination parameters page and limit are respected; totalPages and total reflect all matching published records.
  6. Exhibitions are ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC.
  7. Exhibition fields strictly match /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions plus creator user.
  8. Sensitive credentials (passwords, tokens) and heavy unused JSONB fields (published_data, saved_data) are omitted.
  9. All unit and route integration tests pass (go test ./...).
